# StochasticActivationPerturbation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The deliberate perturbation of neuron activation values using stochastic processes during training or inference. Enables neuromorphic systems to better handle noisy input streams and hardware-induced variations.
